propositions: A ticket directory with no CREATE/SNAPSHOT event causes the plan-relation reducer to fail with reducer-error, making unrelated plan reviews return INDETERMINATE verdict.

The broken ticket directory is unreachable from the ticket being reviewed; the error surfaces only when walking the epic relation graph, causing the blast radius to extend across all tickets in the graph.
Event-less directories are invisible to git and cannot be gitignored because git cannot track empty directories, so they persist in local clones and cannot be repaired by pulling.
The plan-relation reducer must tolerate event-less ticket directories by skipping them with a warning rather than failing the snapshot, to fix existing broken clones and unblock plan reviews.

The writer-side path creates the ticket directory before its first event via os.makedirs, which can leave orphans on process death; this behavior is retained and tolerance is implemented reader-side instead.
